title: Veil and Ember Anew
author: Ada Villalobos
blurb: Petra Joubert, an exiled storm-caller, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
